leads.reason: Nearly all posts are CA shills and call-group pings on several Marvin the Martian copycat coins. One account claims the name links to an Elon Musk tweet naming his pets; that is a single unsupported claim.
Posts of Nov 15 are a coin account's GTA VI giveaway contest, contract-address shills and call-group multiples; one user asks what $rockstar is. No external event or origin behind the word.

The word 'fees' only joins HOGE, Light a Paw and Socks Neobank, which share no story. Posts found concern only HOGE: call-group market-cap shills plus unverified claims that BillyM2k claimed its fees; nothing on the other two.

Fresh posts are call-group and bot posts quoting market cap and contract address, plus one account alleging the deployer rugged earlier; older posts concern an unrelated 2023 coin. No story behind the word.
